name: Rush

whyMatters.en: Toronto power trio formed in 1968. After Neil Peart joined in 1974, long-form prog writing and instrumental detail stayed on rock radio into the 1980s; Moving Pictures (1981) is the main mainstream album.
whyMatters.zh: 多伦多 power trio，1968 年成立。Neil Peart 1974 年加入后，长篇 progressive 写作与乐器细节进入摇滚电台并延续到 1980 年代；《Moving Pictures》（1981）是主要进入主流的专辑。

note.en: From the album 2112; side-long suite with Peart lyrics and hard-rock riff sections.
note.zh: 出自专辑《2112》；整面组曲，含 Peart 歌词与 hard-rock riff 段落。

note.en: From Permanent Waves; radio-length single with a reggae-tinged bridge.
note.zh: 出自《Permanent Waves》；电台长度单曲，桥段偏 reggae。

note.en: From Moving Pictures; Minimoog hook, odd-meter drums, Geddy Lee high tenor.
note.zh: 出自《Moving Pictures》；Minimoog 钩子、奇数拍鼓、Geddy Lee 高男高音。

interviewQuotes.text: What you own is your own kingdom.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Neil Peart

interviewQuotes.text: Three guys trying to sound like more.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Geddy Lee

lyricQuotes: Today's Tom Sawyer / He gets high on you
Begin the day with a friendly voice

shortBio.en: Toronto progressive / hard rock, 1968–2018. Lee, Lifeson, Peart; Tom Sawyer and Moving Pictures are the main synth-era references.
shortBio.zh: 多伦多 progressive / hard rock，1968–2018。Lee、Lifeson、Peart；《Tom Sawyer》与《Moving Pictures》是合成器时期主要参照。

body.en:
Rush formed in Toronto in 1968. Neil Peart joined on drums and lyrics in 1974 after John Rutsey left. 2112 (1976) and Hemispheres (1978) document side-long suites; Permanent Waves (1980) and Moving Pictures (1981) shorten the writing to radio length while keeping odd meters and dense arrangement.

Tom Sawyer (1981) uses a Minimoog hook, Peart’s odd-meter drums, and Geddy Lee’s high vocal. The band remained a trio through Clockwork Angels (2012). Peart retired from touring after 2015; the band ended live activity in 2018.
body.zh:
Rush 于 1968 年在多伦多成立。John Rutsey 离队后，Neil Peart 于 1974 年加入鼓与歌词。《2112》（1976）与《Hemispheres》（1978）记录整面组曲；《Permanent Waves》（1980）与《Moving Pictures》（1981）把写作缩短到电台长度，同时保留奇数拍与密集编曲。

《Tom Sawyer》（1981）使用 Minimoog 钩子、Peart 的奇数拍鼓与 Geddy Lee 的高音人声。乐队以三人组延续至《Clockwork Angels》（2012）。Peart 2015 年后停止巡演；乐队于 2018 年结束现场活动。

body.en:
Geddy Lee plays bass, lead vocal, and keyboards. Alex Lifeson handles arrangement guitar. Neil Peart plays drums and writes lyrics.

Moving Pictures (1981) shortens earlier side-suites into radio-length tracks without dropping odd meters or instrumental detail.
body.zh:
Geddy Lee 负责贝斯、主唱与键盘。Alex Lifeson 负责编曲吉他。Neil Peart 负责鼓与歌词。

《Moving Pictures》（1981）把早期整面组曲缩短为电台长度曲目，同时保留奇数拍与乐器细节。

title.en: From Rutsey to the Peart trio
title.zh: 从 Rutsey 到 Peart 三人组

body.en:
The self-titled debut (1974) features John Rutsey on drums and a hard-rock focus. Peart joins later in 1974.

The classic citation run starts at Fly by Night and continues through Clockwork Angels. The Peart-era trio is the main reference lineup.
body.zh:
同名首专（1974）鼓手为 John Rutsey，偏 hard-rock。Peart 于同年稍后加入。

经典引用区间从《Fly by Night》到《Clockwork Angels》。Peart 时期三人组是主要参照阵容。

body.en:
Minimoog riff, Peart’s odd-meter phrasing, Geddy’s high tenor, and Lifeson chorus guitar sit on Moving Pictures’ polished production.

It is the best-known synth-era Rush single on rock radio.
body.zh:
Minimoog riff、Peart 的奇数拍乐句、Geddy 高男高音，以及 Lifeson 的 chorus 吉他，落在《Moving Pictures》抛光制作上。

这是合成器时期 Rush 在摇滚电台上最知名的单曲。

body.en:
Live, Lee covers bass, lead vocal, and foot-pedal synths. Lifeson favors arpeggios and chord color over shred contests. Peart expands the kit and writes the lyrics.

Geddy’s line “three guys trying to sound like more” describes the arrangement goal.
body.zh:
现场上，Lee 兼贝斯、主唱与脚踏合成器。Lifeson 偏分解和弦与音色，而非 shred 对决。Peart 扩展鼓组并写词。

Geddy 说「三人听起来像更多人」描述的是编曲目标。

body.en:
Peart’s lyrics often return to individual autonomy—an idea already present around 2112. Lee’s interview lines describe trio arrangement density.

Read both against the recorded parts, not as slogans.
body.zh:
Peart 歌词常回到个人自主——《2112》前后已有这一主题。Lee 的采访短句描述三人编曲密度。

对照录音声部阅读，不作口号。

title.en: Influence on later prog and metal
title.zh: 对后来 prog 与金属的影响

body.en:
Tool and other prog-metal acts have cited odd meters and concept writing. Some 1980s–90s metal players also cite Peart’s kit ambition.

Rush kept progressive writing audible on rock radio for a long stretch of the Peart years.
body.zh:
Tool 等 prog-metal 乐队曾引用奇数拍与概念写作。部分 80、90 年代金属乐手也提到 Peart 鼓组野心。

在 Peart 时期相当长一段时间内，Rush 把 progressive 写作留在摇滚电台上。

note.en: Self-titled debut; hard-rock focus before Peart.
note.zh: 同名首专；Peart 加入前偏 hard-rock。

note.en: 2112 through Moving Pictures and later albums; classic trio.
note.zh: 《2112》至《Moving Pictures》及之后专辑；经典三人组。

note.en: Synth-era prog single from Moving Pictures; rock-radio staple.
note.zh: 出自《Moving Pictures》的合成器时期 prog 单曲；摇滚电台常播曲。

note.en: Power-trio prog with dual-duty bass/keys and a lyricist-drummer.
note.zh: 双责贝斯/键盘 + 作词鼓手的 power-trio progressive rock。
